reasons: H4 fit_ok/resolved oracle removal reduces pooled absolute prediction error by 89.2808%; 566/588 rows improve.
State is the largest positive unsafe contribution on 340/356 same-sign underestimated H4 rows; pooled positive underestimation drops 93.8566% under oracle removal.
N2/CO same-time cost-free calibration headroom is 7.2043%-13.7912%; these are molecular development resource cases, NOT measured state-correction savings.
Phase quartets isolate interference exactly for the saved linear imaginary-echo proxy, while retaining a diagonal-population residual.
remaining_unknowns: No exact selected-time state/fit/proxy attribution exists here for the six S0 molecular conditions; the mechanism-to-resource causal bridge is unestablished.
An oracle-free response estimator preserving the exact-ground target and its implementation cost has not been specified or validated.
Controlled phase states depend on exact-ground information and are mechanism diagnostics, not a practical method.
State removal holds the original approximate-state fit fixed; a genuinely corrected fit can have a different residual.
State correction is not uniformly beneficial: cancellation cases worsen, and two-level unsafe-row count increases despite reduced pooled severity.
Post-hoc results on development data do not establish prospective safety, molecular transfer or net resource benefit.
HF is time-domain-limited: same-PF/cap upper saving is only 1.5785%-1.6581%.

recommendation_for_next_stage.first_step: GPT/user review and preregistration of an oracle-free response rule and cost accounting; do not execute science yet.
recommendation_for_next_stage.mechanism_pilot_proposal: One saved H4 Hamiltonian, current_m3, existing CISD input; reuse the original 5 training and 6 evaluation absolute times with both signs. Freeze response/prediction before revealing evaluation truth.
recommendation_for_next_stage.resource_extension_proposal: Only after mechanism support, consider one calibration-oriented N2/CO development condition; never relabel it holdout.

new_science_action_estimate.assumptions: One or two extra response channels/probe states (r=1-2), 11 saved absolute times, both signs; concrete estimator is not yet defined.
new_science_action_estimate.new_PF_actions_at_saved_coordinates: 22*r = 22-44; five training times alone require 10*r = 10-20. If the method requires more channels this estimate changes.
new_science_action_estimate.new_state_preparations: 0-2 time-independent probe states only if the chosen estimator requires them; exact-ground construction is not an operational estimator.
new_science_action_estimate.new_direct_truth_for_later_selected_time: Typically 1-3 selected/local coordinates per one condition, plus any required branch anchor; depends on a separately approved protocol.
new_science_action_estimate.new_fit: One frozen correction/model fit after the estimator is specified; none performed in Phase 0.

recommendation_for_next_stage.approval_status: Proposal only, not a new scientific action authorization or protocol freeze.

alternatives.GO_mechanism_only: Appropriate for HF within its fixed cap, and if an operational estimator or molecular cost advantage cannot be established in a separately approved pilot.
alternatives.NO_GO_state_correction: Not the current overall recommendation because saved H4 mechanism and unsafe-direction evidence are positive; future prospective/cost evidence can still reject a practical method.
